checklistGeneric: Peer review approved on the merge request
Test coverage documented in the pipeline README
checklistSpecific: Unit tests assert transformation output against curated expected fixtures
Integration test runs the pipeline end-to-end on a seeded sample dataset
Great Expectations / dbt test suite committed alongside the pipeline code
Tests execute automatically on every pull request in the CI job
A failing test returns a non-zero exit code that fails the build

testing.expected: CI test job runs the pipeline unit and integration suites on every pull request

checklistGeneric: Threshold configuration recorded in the runbook
checklistSpecific: Pass/fail threshold set per check (e.g. null-rate < 1%, completeness >= 99%)
Warn vs fail severity tiers defined for each gate
Alert routing configured to the on-call data engineering channel
Threshold values sourced from the documented data quality SLA

testing.expected: Each quality check has a configured threshold and an alert channel that fires on breach

checklistGeneric: Specification reviewed and approved by data owner
Document versioned in the shared workspace
checklistSpecific: Ingestion-stage checks specified (schema conformance, row count vs source)
Transform-stage checks specified (business-rule and referential integrity)
Serving-stage checks specified (freshness and completeness thresholds)
Each check maps to a data domain owner and a pass/fail threshold

testing.expected: Quality gate specification lists checks and thresholds for ingestion, transform, and serving stages

checklistGeneric: Escalation follows the documented escalation path
checklistSpecific: Recurring failure raised as a ticket referencing the affected dataset and gate
Source-system owner and data steward named on the escalation
Root-cause owner assigned with a remediation due date
Escalation severity matches the documented severity thresholds

testing.expected: Systemic quality failure has an escalation ticket assigned to the source-system owner and data steward

checklistGeneric: Peer review approved on the merge request
Checks documented in the pipeline runbook
checklistSpecific: Row-count check compares source vs target within an agreed tolerance
Null-rate check per critical column with a defined threshold
Referential-integrity check on foreign keys to reference/master data
Primary-key uniqueness / duplicate check on the target table
Check results emitted as pass/fail with a metric to monitoring

testing.expected: Pipeline run records a pass/fail result for row-count, null-rate, and referential-integrity checks

checklistGeneric: Peer review approved on the merge request
Blocking behaviour documented in the runbook
checklistSpecific: Gate halts the pipeline/DAG run when a critical check returns fail
Downstream tasks are marked upstream-failed and do not execute
Last known-good partition remains published (no partial overwrite)
Blocking event raises an alert to the on-call channel

testing.expected: When a critical quality check fails, downstream tasks do not run and the target partition is not published

checklistGeneric: Peer review approved on the merge request
Pipeline configuration versioned in source control
checklistSpecific: Quality gate job added as a required status check on the pipeline repo
A failing gate returns non-zero and blocks the merge/deploy
Gate runs against a representative sample dataset in the CI environment
Gate results published to the pipeline run summary/artifact

testing.expected: CI pipeline blocks the merge when a quality gate check returns fail

checklistSpecific: Scorecard reports pass rate per quality dimension (completeness, accuracy, timeliness)
Trend line shows gate pass/fail rate over the last N runs
Top failing checks and datasets ranked for the review
Scorecard published to the shared engineering review space on schedule

testing.expected: Quality scorecard shows per-dimension pass rates and a gate failure trend over time

checklistGeneric: Quarantine handling documented in the runbook
checklistSpecific: Failing rows routed to a dedicated quarantine table/zone, not the target
Quarantined records tagged with the failed rule and run id
Valid records continue to load (quarantine does not block clean rows)
Steward review queue notified of new quarantined records

testing.expected: Records failing a quality gate are written to the quarantine table and excluded from the curated target

checklistGeneric: Review outcome communicated to affected consumers
checklistSpecific: Each open failure triaged with a disposition: halt, quarantine, or alert-only
Disposition and rationale recorded against the issue ticket
Data steward sign-off captured for any release/override decision
Repeat failures flagged for root-cause escalation

testing.expected: Each quality gate failure has a recorded disposition (halt/quarantine/alert) with an assigned owner
